resources.string: Sleep Saver turns the sleep your watch records into a sleep-debt number and a daily energy schedule. Here is exactly what it touches.

From Health Connect, with your permission: sleep sessions and sleep stages, and, if you allow them, heart rate, resting heart rate, heart rate variability and steps. Sleep is required; everything else is optional and only used for the Sleep Quality charts.
Nowhere. Everything is stored in a private database on this phone. Sleep Saver has no account, no servers, no analytics and makes no network requests.
Nothing to Health Connect. When you adjust a night, your change is saved inside Sleep Saver next to the original data, so you can always revert it.
You can revoke access at any time in Health Connect settings, export everything as CSV or JSON from Settings, or erase it all with Reset. Uninstalling the app deletes its data.
Sleep Saver is a wellness tool. Its numbers are estimates based on simple models, not a diagnosis. If you are worried about your sleep, talk to a doctor.
